title: Wired Interviews Bill Gates 1996
summary: Unreleased 1996 footage of the Wired editors interviewing Bill Gates when he visited their office. Gates talks about software, the internet and Microsoft's thinking at the time. The video is about 53 minutes long.
why: People recommend it as a rare, unpolished look at Gates's mid-90s thinking, including predictions that aged well and badly.

quote.text: I strongly recommend watching the impromptu interview Bill Gates gave back in the 90s while visiting the Wired office
